title: Lion cub wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='34' fill='#FF9D2E'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='30' fill='#FFB84D'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='40' r='9' fill='#FFB84D'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='40' r='5' fill='#FF8FA3'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='40' r='9' fill='#FFB84D'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='40' r='5' fill='#FF8FA3'/>

  <circle cx='60' cy='51' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <polygon points='47,64 53,64 50,68' fill='#C0392B'/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M50,68 Q45,73 42,71' stroke='#8B4513' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <line x1='76' y1='70' x2='64' y2='70' stroke='#B8860B' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='18' ry='12' fill='#FFD966'/>

  <ellipse cx='38' cy='94' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#FFC933'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='94' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#FFC933'/>
